summary: Terveystalo Oyj provides occupational healthcare services in Finland, Sweden, and Estonia. It operates through three segments: Healthcare Services, Portfolio Businesses, and Sweden. The company offers general practice and specialist medical care, diagnostic, outpatient surgery, dental, and other adjacent services; healthcare outsourcing and staffing services; child welfare services; and oral health, social, ER, well-being, and primary healthcare and specialty care services, as well as imaging and laboratory tests. It also provides remote and digital, diagnostic and screening, therapy and rehabilitation, and occupational health; leasing of personnel, partnership solutions, and assessment of the need for care; and organizational management consulting and addiction prevention services. The company serves private individuals and families, corporate and consumer, insurance companies, and public sector customers. Terveystalo Oyj was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
